text: The family approved these prices. Carrying the estimate onto the bill keeps them exactly as approved, and saves typing it all again.
Juniper's dental estimate was approved. Her bill has the exam on it so far.
Don't type the lines again. Find the estimate.
Scout lists this family's open estimates, newest first. Declined, converted and expired ones don't show.
Open it to check what's inside.
Every pet, every line, at the prices the family approved.
Convert adds the whole estimate to this bill.
If something wasn't done, remove that line. Add anything that came up during the procedure.
You can also start from the estimate. It's on the client's Estimates list.
An estimate made on the ledger isn't tied to a visit yet, so Scout asks which one. It lists the family's visits today and coming up.
Then click Convert to this visit.
The bill is open on that visit, and the estimate shows Converted.
The most common mistake is retyping the estimate on the bill. Remember: carry the estimate onto the bill with Find estimate, so you don't re-enter the lines.
